newsitem.title: UK: Britain warns N.Ireland "loyalists" on peace talks.
newsitem.headline: Britain warns N.Ireland "loyalists" on peace talks.

text.p: Britain warned on Tuesday that recent bombings blamed on pro-British guerrillas could lead to expulsion of Protestant "Loyalist" parties from multi-party talks on the future of Northern Ireland.

A Northern Ireland Office statement said recent attacks on Catholics who want an end to British rule "inevitably raise questions over the position in the Northern Ireland talks of the two parties associated with the Loyalist paramilitaries."
